questions.question: A motorcycle costs Rs. 60,000. If the depreciation rate is 15%, what would be its cost after one year?
questions.solution:
**FORMULA:**

A = P(1 - R/100)^t

Where,

A = depreciated amount after t years

P = current cost of that product

R = depreciation rate

t = number of years the product has been depreciated.

**CALCULATION:**

P = 60,000

R = 15 % and t = 1

A = 60000(1 - 15/100)¹

A = 60000 × 85 / 100

A = 51000

Hence, **Rs. 51,000** is the answer.

questions.question: Select the number-pair which is NOT related in the same say as are the other number-pairs
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

The left side digit is multiplied with its next consecutive number and the result is on the right side.

questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

7, 24, 75, 228, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

7 × 3 + 3 = 24,

24 × 3 + 3 = 75,

75 × 3 + 3 = 228,

**228 × 3 + 3 = 687**,

Hence, **687** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(2, 16, 32)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The 2nd number is obtained by raising 4th power to the first number.

The 3rd number is obtained by double the 2nd number.

2⁴ = 16 and 16 × 2 = 32

only option (1) satisfy the following condition

4⁴ = 256 and 256 × 2 = 512,

Hence, **(4, 256, 512)** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which among the following options is a correct possibility if the given figure is folded to form a dice?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54317a40afda065a9e99a203921756631ac3e3da037765a7be40555ff7e54666.png]
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__ :

Types of figure generally given in the exams.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef6ed6aee3d5ecabe3f341a236e6cf99869233ca76d1249e9a384b13d8c922ab.png] 

The clearly seen alternate position of the open dice becomes the opposite pair after folding and the two remaining faces also become opposite to each other.

Here, In every figure:

A is opposite to C.

B is opposite to D.

Thus the remaining, E is opposite to F.

__EXPLANATION __:

The alternate position of faces becomes opposite to each other, as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bda0da55f87a3ec52852e74e1e32f633b408873146b5978ba6e467b6a70979e5.png] 

The opposite pairs are (5 - 2), (3 - 4), and (6 - 1).

The opposite pair can't be the adjacent faces or can't appear together in the dice.

Option 1, Option 3, Option 4 are not possible because the opposite faces come in adjacent places.

__CONCLUSION __:

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

questions.question:

questions.solution:
Adjacent faces will never come for opposite faces.

In figure first, the adjacent face of ! are $ and %.

In figure second, the adjacent face of ! are # and @.

so, they must not appear opposite to !.

Thus, options 2 ,3, 4 will be eliminated,

Hence, **option (1)** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__** Here we can't see the face of the sixth symbol,

so we need to go with the options accordingly.

If 2 new symbols appear then both of them are correct,

or no new symbol then the answer will be cannot be determined.
